scope: A100 40GB; one steady AR chunk (calls 16-19), four denoising steps plus AR updates and preparation before call 20; no model loading or VAE decode in trace.
comparison: Eager versus ordinary strict regional torch.compile. FP8 storage / BF16 compute. Same input hashes and source hashes. Autotuning and CUDA graphs disabled.
validation: Three unprofiled controls per mode; one capture per mode after one full warmup. 51 graphs unchanged across every compiled request, no graph breaks. All ten full requests produced 257 frames and finite final latents.
harness_metadata_correction: Executed source described synchronization only at boundaries; that meant harness-added synchronization. Implicit model waits remain. Final source clarifies this wording without changing execution.

findings.interpretation: Launch overhead does not appear dominant in this window: profiled GPU gaps are 3.10% eager and 2.21% compiled. Most recorded time reduction is in GPU activity. Host launch API and synchronization durations overlap GPU execution, and are not additive exposed overhead. Active intervals are not an SM-utilization measurement. No causal attribution of every gap or tested CUDA-graph speedup.
